head: 5b27c69e71e96f29173388f6930c99cba373f11e
method: own PowerShell reader of target/stage2-impl/window/product/*.json and docs/development-evidence/g10-p5-gpu-kernels/gpu-window/cases/<case>/out1/*.bin; own re-implementation of the G5 criterion (dist 4 ULP @ own magnitude or 4 ULP@1.0 for ref==0, pos 4*ULP(scale), frame 4 ULP@1.0, count/world/overflow equal, worldid grouping + stable sort, row order not a criterion). Delivery scripts/tests were not used for these numbers.

detail.ellipsoid-box Contact: raw run1/run2 arrays differ only by row order (run1 worldid=1,0; run2 worldid=0,1; same dist/pos/frame value multiset); after worldid grouping + G5 sort key the rows are bit-identical
detail.all_other_16_dumps: raw arrays equal, normalized equal as well

dump_two_run_determinism.conclusion: the claim '9 case dump two runs bit-identical' holds only after the G5 row-order normalization; one dump (ellipsoid-box Contact) is not raw-array identical. The delivery window doc section 4 discloses the row-order issue, but the UNC-2 qualifier text does not carry that qualifier.

record_b_independent_recompute.criterion_ref: G5 frozen device criterion (bit first, else 4 ULP; row order normalized)
record_b_independent_recompute.matches_delivery_record_b: exactly (same bit_equal/total, same max values, same failure counts and failure texts; delivery record-b.json was not used to derive these numbers)
record_b_independent_recompute.red_items: sphere-box-deep and capsule-box are red under this comparison; delivery classifies them reference_not_comparable

classification_check.g5_11_2_basis: confirmed in docs/development-evidence/g10-p5-gpu-kernels/README.md section 11.2 (lines 198-205): upstream collision_driver dispatch routes (SPHERE,BOX) and (CAPSULE,BOX) through primitive_narrowphase, so the frozen probe out1 ccd branch is not bound to the upstream reference; the same section names sphere-box-shallow/deep and capsule-box together.
classification_check.list_completeness_finding: the not-comparable rule in section 11.2 names THREE cases (sphere-box-shallow, sphere-box-deep, capsule-box). Delivery record B flags only deep and capsule as reference_not_comparable, while sphere-box-shallow is counted as a valid-reference pass (0 failures, 15/26 bit-equal). The exclusion rationale therefore applies asymmetrically: the passing case stays in the green subset, the failing ones are excluded by the same rule.
classification_check.impact: does not change 'not B full green'; the evaluable green subset claimed by delivery includes sphere-box-shallow, which per the cited section is not a bound upstream reference either
classification_check.corroborating_fact: the window device tests C-prim (tests exist at HEAD) show the product primitive launcher matching the QA upstream GPU reference 80/80 bit-equal for sphere-box-shallow/deep/capsule-box, which is consistent with those cases not belonging to the ccd comparison in the first place

record_c_cross_recipe.status: delivery writes it as recorded envelope (no pass/fail); my read of target/stage2-impl/window/result.json is consistent with that; host and device use different known recipes, so this is not a host-vs-device equality claim
record_c_cross_recipe.note: record C failures include expected cross-recipe differences; it is not used to judge the task

record_a_host_vs_upstream_cpu_reference.delivery_source: cited existing verified fix-r2 evidence (50a0acd1) for the G2 five cases and G3 for sdf-box; primitive three cases recorded as not applicable because host has no primitive implementation path in this comparison
record_a_host_vs_upstream_cpu_reference.qa_action: read-only cross reference; not re-run in this check (fix-r2 was already independently reviewed by QA in the same chain)

traceability: all equivalence inputs used here live in the gitignored target/stage2-impl/window/ tree (attempt4 logs, product dumps, record-b.json, result.json, three-records.json); only summaries are committed in docs/development-evidence/g10-p5-cuda-default-pipeline-stage2/.
